Steps: As the payer, Edit an expense, attach a photo, Save changes.
Expected Result: Receipt button appears on the expense in Transactions.

Steps: As the payer, Edit an expense and choose a non-image file.
Expected Result: Blocked with a message: Receipts must be a photo.
The photo is shown in a dialog; Escape or × closes it.

Steps: As a member who did not pay, open the expense.
Expected Result: Receipt button is visible; Edit and Delete are not.

Steps: As the payer, Edit an expense with a receipt, click Remove, Save changes.
Expected Result: Receipt button disappears from the expense.

Steps: As the payer, delete an expense that has a receipt.
Expected Result: Expense and its receipt are both removed.
